statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-66032: a double free in sftp_open() in src/sftp.c that a malicious server can trigger in a client opening an SFTP file. It is fixed upstream by https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/5e4776146552d898b9c0e1b313cd093fa8dc92d0 (https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/pull/2180), and Alpine lists it as fixed in 1.11.1-r4 in the secfixes of its libssh2 recipe (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/libssh2/APKBUILD). We checked every published libssh2 build for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, 1.11.1-r1 to 1.11.1-r5, on x86_64 and aarch64, each verified against its index checksum: the shared library /usr/lib/libssh2.so.1.0.1 (libssh2) and the static library /usr/lib/libssh2.a (libssh2-static), with function boundaries taken from the libssh2-dbg debug symbols and from the static library's symbol table. 1.11.1-r4 carries a backport of the upstream commit, and 1.11.1-r5 is rebuilt from Alpine's 1.11.1-r4 recipe, which carries the same commit. sftp_open() changes between 1.11.1-r3 and 1.11.1-r4 on both architectures, and its machine code is byte-identical between 1.11.1-r4 and 1.11.1-r5 in both the shared and the static library. 1.11.1-r4 is the first fixed build, and every later build carries the fix.

CVE-2026-66032: a double free in sftp_open() in src/sftp.c that a malicious server can trigger in a client opening an SFTP file. It is fixed upstream by https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/commit/5e4776146552d898b9c0e1b313cd093fa8dc92d0 (https://github.com/libssh2/libssh2/pull/2180). Debian fixed it for trixie in 1.11.1-1+deb13u2 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66032, https://bugs.debian.org/1142856). We checked every published libssh2 build for Debian 13 based on 1.11.1-1+deb13u1 or later in the DHI Debian repository, on amd64 and arm64, each verified against its index checksum: the shared library libssh2.so.1.0.1 (libssh2-1t64), the static library libssh2.a (libssh2-1-dev) and the libssh2-1t64-dbgsym debug symbols. The range's fixed version is a DHI rebuild of 1.11.1-1+deb13u1 whose Debian changelog records a backport of Debian's patches for this CVE, ahead of Debian's own 1.11.1-1+deb13u2. In that build sftp_open() differs from the two earlier 1.11.1-1+deb13u1 builds and is byte-identical to the build of Debian's 1.11.1-1+deb13u2, in both the shared and the static library, on both architectures. Every later build carries the fix.
